notes: Choosing a weather icon set now shows you the icons. It shipped as a dropdown listing the words Line, Solid and Emoji, which tells you nothing about what you are picking.

It is now three tiles, each drawing the real icons that set will use — clear, rain and storm, because those differ most between the sets and a set should not be judged on its sunny day alone. The chosen tile is marked, and the drawn sets…
This is the standard the Visuals tab already arrived at: a style choice is shown, not named. That rule existed and was not followed here.
